يستشبوا (form X)
# يَسْتَشِبُّوا (yastašibbū) /jas.ta.ʃib.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
# يُسْتَشَبُّوا (yustašabbū) /jus.ta.ʃab.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
